title: Craftable and cheaper items
description: This datapack makes minecraft crafting recipes way cheaper and some items that werent supposed to be crafted! currently the newest version is 1.6.0. The amount of modified items to make their recipes cheaper is 3, and the new craftable items is 8!
body:
### What is this datapack?
This datapack makes minecraft crafting recipes so much better! Like some modified items crafting recipe are either way cheaper, or... other items that arent supposed to be craftable! like the anvil, hate the 31 ingot recipe? well worry no more! now its just 3 cobblestone slab, 1 cobblestone, and 3 smooth stone. And other items that arent supposed to be craftable like bell, just 3 sticks, and 1 gold block!

This description tells each version of each recipe, but theyre not all listed because i cannot remember of what i added for each version (should have done this in the start to be honest)

### Current versions:
- 1.0.0
- 1.1.0
- 1.2.0
- 1.3.0
- 1.4.0
- 1.5.0
- 1.5.1
- 1.6.0
- 1.7.0
- 1.8.0
- 1.9.0

### Note:
this datapack was made by a [crafting generator website](https://crafting.thedestruc7i0n.ca/). Click here to make your own datapack (for crafting, etc.)!

also check out [the new project](https://modrinth.com/datapack/iron-to-diamond) i made!

### Whats new?

- Craftable sand
- Cheaper arrows
- Craftable leather
